newsitem.title: ESTONIA: TALINVEST'S VOUCHER FUND TO ISSUE NEW SHARES.
newsitem.headline: TALINVEST'S VOUCHER FUND TO ISSUE NEW SHARES.

text.p: Talinvest's Estonian voucher investment fund will issue 388,157 new shares to increase its share capital by 14 million kroons from its present 16 million, it said on Wednesday.
The price of a 20 par value share is 36 kroons, deputy director Johann Sulling told Reuters.
The subscription period is between June 25 to July 9.
Sulling said the fund plans to restructure its securities portfolio and start investing into Latvian and Lithuanian companies.
In Latvia, the fund is interested in companies which will be privatised for vouchers, he added.
When the portfolio is restructured and the money invested, the fund plans a new issue in the autumn, Sulling said.
